brands.evidence: While Monzo is widely praised in the UK for its budgeting tools and user-friendly app, customer complaints generally fall into a few recurring categories

client_claims.text: Monzo was fined £21.1m by the FCA in July 2025 over past financial crime control failings
free-tier users face strict limits and fees for depositing cash (via PayPoint) and withdrawing cash abroad
client_claims.note: Free plan has a £200 allowance outside the EEA, then a 3% fee; cash deposit limits are not covered.

client_claims.text: Monzo's paid tiers are Extra, Perks and Max
higher savings interest rates are increasingly locked behind paid tiers
client_claims.note: Facts give only the free-plan rate.

client_claims.text: Monzo is digital-only with no physical branches
Financial Ombudsman Service data has previously highlighted a relatively high overturn rate for Monzo's fraud decisions
Monzo issues 60-day closure notices and refuses to explain why accounts are flagged or closed
